observations: All eight current views are explicitly marked “Missing display parts: slanted_back_panel,” and the supplied render status independently lists slanted_back_panel as missing because its evaluated mesh is degenerate.

The remaining displayed assembly retains two full-height side panels and three distinct horizontal shelves. The frontal views (attachments 1 and 4) remain broadly symmetric, while oblique views 2, 3, 5, and 6 show the shelf ends supported between the side panels.

The current evidence supersedes the earlier appearance-only diagnosis that the back panel’s existing -7° lean was merely difficult to see: in these renders the entire slanted_back_panel is omitted, so neither its presence nor its required visible inclination is preserved.
The displayed geometry remains monochromatic matte black, but weak separation from the nearly black background continues to obscure panel and shelf boundaries.
Dimensions, connection topology, fit allowance, mate-frame validity, and the six-part assignment cannot be visually certified from these partial diagnostic renders.
required_changes: Restore slanted_back_panel as a valid, separately displayed print part. Correct the local degenerate geometry causing zero-area triangles while preserving its intended mild Y-Z lean, upper-rear placement, back_panel_joint, coordinated tilted mate frame, fit_offset_mm=0.2, and the frozen 1125 × 450 × 1800 mm envelope. Re-export and verify the panel is present and visibly slanted in profile-revealing views.

issues.problem: The required upper slanted back panel is completely absent from every current view (attachments 1–8). Each render explicitly reports “Missing display parts: slanted_back_panel,” and the render evidence identifies a degenerate evaluated mesh with zero-area triangles. This violates the explicit requirements to preserve all six separate print parts and retain a visibly slanted upper back panel.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the smallest local source correction to the slanted_back_panel face/solid construction that eliminates the reported degenerate triangles without deleting, fusing, or replacing the part. Preserve the existing intended inclination and coordinate any body correction with tilted_vertical, the back-panel placement, and connect_back_panel_to_right_side. Re-export, recheck the interface, and confirm that oblique/profile views clearly show the panel between the side panels and within the frozen bounds.

issues.problem: Attachments 1–8 remain heavily underexposed against a nearly black background. This reduces silhouette separation and would make the required back-panel inclination difficult to assess even after the missing panel is restored.
issues.suggested_fix: Increase rim or directional illumination or slightly lift the background/exposure while retaining the monochromatic matte-black material and avoiding contrasting connector colors.
